newsitem.title: USA: Tupperware tumbles on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Tupperware tumbles on earnings warning.

text.p: The stock of Tupperware Corp. tumbled Tuesday, losing more than 18 percent of its value, one day after the maker of plastic storage products warned that it expects lower profits for the first quarter.
Tupperware was off $8.125 at $36 on the New York Stock Exchange.
The company said its first-quarter earnings will be down from a year ago because of lower-than-expected sales and the impact of unfavourable currency fluctuations.
"We are disappointed to report a softer than expected outlook for March, our key month in the quarter," Warren Batts, Tupperware chairman and chief executive officer, said on Monday.
Tupperware reported earnings per share of 46 cents in last year's first quarter, and Wall Street analysts' were expecting the company to earn profits equal to 51 cents a share.
